text: The successful candidate will stand up the new division and build the team from scratch.
Requires a 0-to-1 leader who can build our APAC operations from the ground up.
Expected to scale the business and team from 10 to 100 people during hyperscale.
Tasked with driving a 10x growth trajectory for the division.
Lead the business transformation and digital transformation of our core CRM platform.
Responsible for the modernization and operating model redesign of legacy operations.
Requires a turnaround specialist who can restructure the division and stabilize performance.
Will oversee a reset of the operational execution to reverse declining revenues.
Manage post-merger integration and M&A integration after key corporate acquisitions.
Responsible for PMI execution to align merged business lines.
Will restructure operations to stabilize them and then scale the business from 10x growth.
Lead digital transformation of our legacy core and stand up a new division from scratch.
Collaborate closely with various teams to maintain current day-to-day operations.
Must fit within the existing culture and maintain the status quo.
This is a caretaker role focused on keeping things running smoothly.
Assess need for future scaling, although immediate focus is steady-state ops.
Work closely with integration consultants to understand past PMIs.
Must have basic understanding of digital transformation principles.
Report to the turnaround manager and assist with documentation.
Help with team alignment exercises during reorganizations.
